::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** April 13th 1878  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54921: 62
:::

Dear [Mr Craik](people/person_379.qmd)

I send the end of [the Story of the Christians and Moors](cmy_books/cmybook_126.qmd). It makes 27 chapters, and I think more would outrun the limits besides the history  of the poor Moriscos is so piteous that I do not like to go into it

Yours truly
C M Yonge
